title: Take back your power: Anker SOLIX brings the next extreme with solar energy storage solutions
summary: Anker SOLIX, the dedicated clean energy and portable power solutions brand of Anker Innovations, enters the Philippines with the ambition to make decentralized energy more economically accessible for…

blocks.text: Anker SOLIX, the dedicated clean energy and portable power solutions brand of Anker Innovations, enters the Philippines with the ambition to make decentralized energy more economically accessible for Filipino households, targeting an approximate 3-year payback period1 for a typical residential solar storage installation. Launched through a strategic partnership between NAVCO, a leading distributor and retailer of global consumer electronics brands in the Philippines, and GoPrime, the solar energy solutions company behind GoSolar, the launch comes at an opportune time, as electricity costs in the Philippines remain among the highest in Southeast Asia, alongside continued challenges with grid reliability and unpredictable weather.
As the Philippines moves toward more decentralized energy solutions, solar paired with storage offers an alternative to relying solely on traditional backup power.

“The Philippines is uniquely positioned for this transition to decentralized energy because the need is not only environmental—it is economic and practical. High electricity costs, grid challenges, and the country’s exposure to typhoons make energy independence increasingly relevant to everyday Filipino households,” said Symons Xie, General Manager of Anker SOLIX .
Three new energy solutions for Filipino homes
At the center of the launch were three Anker SOLIX products designed to meet different household energy needs—from portable backup power to comprehensive home energy management.

The SOLIX XE Hybrid is a whole-home energy solution designed to provide backup power while enabling greater solar self-consumption. When paired with 8 to 10 solar panels, the system can generate an estimated 7,440 to 9,300 kWh annually based on a Manila-area benchmark of approximately 1,550 equivalent full-load hours per year. This can deliver approximately ₱64,700 to ₱80,900 in annual electricity offset or savings, based on an assumed electricity rate of ₱14.50/kWh2.

Meanwhile, the SolarBank 4 is positioned as an accessible entry point for households looking to get started in decentralized energy. When paired with 4 panels, the SolarBank 4 can generate an estimated 3,720 kWh annually, with approximately 2,230 kWh potentially self-consumed. With six panels, the estimated annual generation rises to approximately 5,580 kWh. Depending on the household’s system configuration, this can deliver approximately ₱32,300 to ₱48,600 in annual electricity offset, based on the assumed electricity rate of ₱14.50/kWh.

Rounding out the lineup is the S2000, designed for those looking for a more portable energy solution. Recognizing a market gap for high-quality, plug-and-play energy solutions, the S2000 is able to provide clean power in a more portable form for those who work remotely, travel or are outdoors frequently, or live in smaller homes.
NAVCO and GoPrime Partner to Build a Nationwide Energy Solutions Ecosystem

Anker SOLIX now moves to solidifying its presence in the country, with plans to expand across retail and e-commerce not just in Metro Manila but in Visayas and Mindanao, while also exploring local installment financing partnerships and actively building out its EPC installer network to strengthen local installation and service capabilities in more areas.

This will be achieved through a combination of NAVCO’s nationwide brand-building, distribution, retail, and sales capabilities together with GoSolar’s expertise in solar energy engineering, system design, installation, and technical support.

Under the partnership, NAVCO will lead product importation, distribution, brand marketing, and retail development, while GoSolar will spearhead technical solutions, installation services, and after-sales technical support for applicable home energy systems.

“This launch is the beginning of a long-term commitment — we are here to grow with the market, expand our local presence and product portfolio, and help shape a Philippine energy future that is more resilient, more sustainable, and always on,” shares Ryan Tan, President of the NAVCO Group.

As the brand continues to expand its presence, capabilities, and portfolio in the Philippines, it remains focused on delivering its promise of the Next Extreme in energy – extreme savings, extreme storage, extreme sustainability.
